history.answer: Mount Leyshon, an abandoned gold mine located 23.8 km south of Charters Towers, produced a total of 107,670.417 kg of gold between 1986 and 2002, equivalent to approximately 3.46 Moz troy. The mine also produced 68,900 kg of silver and 73,133,075 tonnes of ore during the same period. The mine operated in two distinct periods: from 1872 to 1916 and from 1986 to 2002. It closed in 2002, though no specific reason for the closure is provided in the available records. Ownership of the site has changed over time, with Mount Isa Mines Ltd holding tenure from 1960 to 1961, and Leyshon Resources Limited being the current owner.

survey.answer: Mount Leyshon (Geological Survey of Queensland site 38940) is recorded as an abandoned mine on the Charters Towers 1:100,000 sheet (23.8km south of charters towers), at -20.2907, 146.2718, located to within 100 m. The survey classes its gold as large, 50-150 t, and also records silver (small). Within 5 km it records 30 other historical workings, 29 of them with gold; other commodities nearby: copper, lead, silver, zinc. The record gives a size band, not production figures, and holds no owners or closure dates.

structured_record.answer: Mount Leyshon (GSQ site 38940, 23.8km south of charters towers) is recorded by the Geological Survey of Queensland as abandoned mine, gold size band large, 50 - 150 t. Reported production: 107,670.417 kg gold, about 3.46 Moz troy (converted here; the survey records 107,670.417 kg) (1986 to 2002, Mount Leyshon, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Total_Ores_Prod, SITE_NO 38940)); 68,900 kg silver (1986 to 2002, Mount Leyshon, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Total_Ores_Prod, SITE_NO 38940)); 73,133,075 tonnes ore (1986 to 2002, Mount Leyshon, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Total_Ores_Prod, SITE_NO 38940)). GSQ MINOCC 2017 also lists 13 dated Production rows (gold: 24,793 kg 1986 to 1991; 6,115.223 kg 1991; 6,719.118 kg 1992; 6,823.469 kg 1993; 7,263.27 kg 1994; 7,376.169 kg 1995; 5,971.682 kg 1996; 7,043.771 kg 1997; 7,620.235 kg 1998; 9,784.2 kg 1998 to 1999; 8,801.74 kg 1999 to 2000; 7,270.78 kg 2000 to 2001; 2,087.76 kg 2001 to 2002); see production. Closure: 2002 (no reason quoted) [Mount Leyshon, unknown, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (MineHist, SITE_NO 38940, row 2)]. Years worked per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (MineHist, SITE_NO 38940): 1872-1916, 1986-2002. Ownership and tenure: Leyshon Resources Limited per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Tenure, SITE_NO 38940); Mount Isa Mines Ltd (1960 to 1961) per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Explorer, SITE_NO 38940, row 1). GSQ MINOCC 2017 lists 9 company reports for this site: CR 497, CR 2823, CR 12412, CR 12413, CR 15066, CR 30415, CR 31111, CR 32302, .... Not found: closure reason: the indexed sources give a closure year but quote no reason.
